message:
Add `WithFailFast()` (#118)

In https://github.com/sourcegraph/conc/pull/104, a "FailFast" option is
likely going to be added to iterators that, on error, stops running
additional tasks and returns the error that caused the first failure.

"FailFast" seems is a pretty standard description for this behavior, and
combining two common options into a single option with a more
discoverable name seems like a nice thing to do before 1.0.

pr.title: Add `WithFailFast()`
pr.body:
In https://github.com/sourcegraph/conc/pull/104, a "FailFast" option is likely going to be added to iterators that, on error, stops running additional tasks and returns the error that caused the first failure. 

"FailFast" seems is a pretty standard description for this behavior, and combining two common options into a single option with a more discoverable name seems like a nice thing to do before 1.0.

explanation.what: ContextPool と ResultContextPool に `WithFailFast()` メソッドを追加した。中身は `WithFirstError()` と `WithCancelOnError()` を組み合わせて呼ぶだけのエイリアス。既存テストの "WithFirstError and WithCancelOnError" は "WithFailFast" に置き換えられ、ResultContextPool 側にも同種のテストを新設した。
explanation.why: PR本文によると、#104 で iterator 側にエラー時に以降のタスクを止めて最初のエラーを返す "FailFast" オプションが追加される見込みであり、それに先立って pool 側でも「最初のエラーで打ち切り、そのエラーを返す」という2つの既存オプションの組み合わせに、より発見しやすい名前を付けて 1.0 リリース前に整理しておく狙いがあった。

highlights.note: WithFirstError+WithCancelOnError を束ねる WithFailFast の追加
